cab29c52001b42.s: The Computer Didi–Didi Ka Dukan pilot in Andhra Pradesh is located in:

ca681b48f3da98.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's development plans?

The State aims to double per capita income every ten years.
A nutrition plan covers Anna Canteen beneficiaries.
The State aims to double GSDP every five years.
ca681b48f3da98.x: The target is to double GSDP and per capita income every five years, not ten; the nutrition plan covers Mid-Day Meal, Anganwadi and Anna Canteen beneficiaries.

ca0563a1d726ac.s: Natural farming in Andhra Pradesh is implemented through:

ca815ddcaa8867.x: Patients registered at the Guntur ART centre in 2004 were reported to be still alive.

cafae1b458ca84.x: Private patta lands were among the five categories removed; conditional patta, service inam and freehold lands are still pending before a Group of Ministers.

ca2efb6d07802a.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's land reforms, who were empowered to cancel fake or double registrations?
ca2efb6d07802a.x: The land reforms empowered Collectors to cancel fake or double registrations. (No dated facts for a sequence, so written as a one-liner.)

caf83fdf88f74f.s: In Andhra Pradesh's governance initiatives, AWARE stands for:
caf83fdf88f74f.x: AWARE = AP Wide Area Real-time Execution; WhatsApp governance and DG Verify are among AP's other initiatives.

caadf933cfdc02.x: Banaganapalle is in Nandyala district; Madakasira went to Sri Sathya Sai.

ca0bade2660929.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed realignment in the Krishna/NTR region?

A new Mylavaram Revenue Division would replace Vuyyuru.
A new Gannavaram Revenue Division would replace Vuyyuru.

ca51fab67efc37.s: Project Sanjeevani integrates Ayushman Bharat and NTR health services with:
ca51fab67efc37.x: Project Sanjeevani integrates Ayushman Bharat, NTR health services and global practices.

cadcf17416dfeb.s: Under the proposed CMEGP, the project ceiling for a manufacturing unit is:

ca119dcd92e4d3.x: LEAP aims at one entrepreneur per household; it was launched at Tadepalli.

ca2d9220748198.s: According to UDISE data for 2014–2024, the number of government schools in Andhra Pradesh:

cac9b17f78cf4c.x: ISO 50001:2018 is Energy Management; ISO 21001:2018 is Educational Organisation and ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management.

ca5a4f337cc95e.s: Andhra Pradesh's BPS 2025 excludes constructions made after:
ca5a4f337cc95e.x: BPS 2025 excludes public land and constructions made after 31 August 2025.

ca04a729bb4894.s: Under the proposed APPSC Group-I reforms, the validity of the Computer Proficiency Test is:
ca04a729bb4894.x: The proposed CPT validity is two years, not one.

ca28126eea542e.s: On 1 August 2024, by what majority did the Supreme Court uphold sub-classification of Scheduled Castes?
ca28126eea542e.x: A 7-judge bench upheld sub-classification by a 6:1 majority.

BPS 2019 covered constructions made from 1985 to 2019.

ca977032460654.x: The Articles involved are 14–16; the relevant Directive Principles are 38, 39, 41 and 46.

cab9da869adc95.x: The Begging Bill focused on rehabilitation; the Shops Bill on working conditions and the Factories Bill on working hours.

ca081b26377870.x: One lead farmer per panchayat across 722 gram panchayats in 37 mandals gives 722 Farmer Champions.

nd4392094a65.x: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva covers 3,257 procedures.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh's 2025 review, welfare disbursement to 67.27 lakh beneficiaries amounted to:

new.s: Under the AP Police health insurance scheme, what is the cover for personnel below 55 years?

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the AP Police health insurance scheme:
1. The first-year premium is paid by the police department.
2. It covers the spouse and two children.
3. It covered 2,576 families in its first year.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: the department pays the first-year premium, cover extends to spouse and 2 children, and 2,576 families (10,304 beneficiaries) were covered in year one.

new.s: Along with the Gram/Ward Secretariat Bill–2026, which draft bill did the AP Cabinet approve on 11 February 2026?

new.x: DDO offices were inaugurated on 4 December to strengthen Panchayat Raj.

2. The final decision rests with the Governor.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only 1 is correct: objections go to a cabinet subcommittee, but the final decision is by the Chief Minister.

new.x: CVAP graded all 175 constituencies on 685 indicators.

new.x: Guntur West (73) was last and the only B–; Vijayawada West (93) topped.

new.x: 10% of Andhra Yatri fees go to the government.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (first – place) is correctly matched?

First city in AP with CVIRMS – Tirupati
India's first Centralised Advanced Smart Kitchen – Kuppam
First Swachha Andhra Awards ceremony – 15 August 2025

new.x: Talliki Vandanam gives ₹13,000 per child per year to mothers.
